subject: note: Which brings me back to my suicide note creative writing workshop, as I didn’t recount the best part of the story. After I’d finished my little talk, I distributed small white index cards and invited everyone present to write their own suicide notes.
note: As paradoxical as it might sound, the decision to end one’s life is a requirement of life in order to escape a life of indignity and incarceration, the life of the concentration camp.
note: As Freud writes elsewhere, hate is older…
